reviewer: AI visual inspection of actual Blender renders
intended_use: editable static stylized low-poly character blockout-plus

observed_iteration.defect: Initial side render showed flat shirt, tie, and lapel panels floating ahead of the tapered torso; fringe read too vertically.
observed_iteration.change: Fitted clothing panel vertices to the torso envelope, shortened the shirt opening, increased lateral hair sweep, and reduced dark-material specular response.
observed_iteration.result: Re-rendered front and side views show fitted clothing and a clearer side-swept silhouette.

confirmed_visual_features: Deliberate jaw, cheek, temple, and forehead planes rather than a single ellipsoid head
Scalp cap and solid side-swept hair locks
Tailored dark jacket with notched lapels, shirt, tie, and subtle gold details
Four jointed fingers with varied lengths and an opposed thumb on the inspected hand
Profiled trousers and tapered shoe lasts with separate soles
limitations: Facial planes and hair grouping remain stylized and lower-frequency than a production anime/manhwa sculpt
Dark hair lock separation depends on lighting and viewing angle
Static T-pose hands and overlapping components have no deformation or grip validation
Only the right hand received a separate close-up; the left is generated by mirrored parameters but was not separately close-up reviewed
No reference likeness, UV, rigging, skinning, animation, or target-engine performance assessment was performed
